issueSummary: The homepage has a recognizable local-service look but lacks a clear above-fold service promise, task-specific service paths, next-step guidance, and has trust issues from Wix residue plus a captured phone-link mismatch.
topFindings: Homepage hero is mostly an equipment image with no clear air duct/dryer vent value proposition or specific CTA before the contact form.
Visible Wix builder banner and dated/template cues weaken trust for a home-service contractor.
Services and next steps are hidden or unclear; homeowners need faster routing to air duct cleaning, dryer vent cleaning, and commercial duct cleaning.
preservedDesign: Preserved white header, Atlas-style blue logo mark, hours/phone/badge row, black/gray nav tabs, large equipment-image hero feel, royal-blue contact block, map/form layout, and floating chat cue.
criticalCoverageStatus: All critical findings were fixed or improved in the prototype: clearer hero/CTAs, removed builder banner, and standardized phone CTA to the visible (385) 497-6505 number.
